## Episode Thesis

This is a political episode about the aftermath of the Swedish election, with Matilda Molander, CEO of the green-liberal think tank Fores, as guest. The discussion covers how the Centre Party's red lines against V and SD will shape who forms the government, and expects a change of government towards Magdalena Andersson with a softer migration policy. The guest expects C and S to resist billionaire and capital taxes, but says she would worry if she owned a free-school company, because profits in the school sector could be conceded to V. No listed company gets a directional view; the only companies named appear in sponsor ads.
